entries.head: Ripple Prime opens 24/7 swaps on 100+ stock, metal and currency markets, with Virtu trading
entries.fact: On October 15 Ripple Prime launched swaps for institutional clients that track more than 100 markets across equities, indices, ETFs, metals, energy and currencies. Each swap references a perpetual futures contract that Trade.xyz lists on Hyperliquid, and Virtu is already trading them.
entries.numLabel: reference markets covered by the swaps
entries.mechanism: Ripple Prime takes the other side of each swap as principal, so clients never trade on Hyperliquid directly. Positions sit in one prime account, can be cross-margined with other assets, and can be collateralized with Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin where available.
entries.implication: Onchain perpetual markets are now reachable through a regulated-style prime broker, extending round-the-clock price exposure to traditional assets without tokenizing the assets themselves.
evidence: Trading and settlement run 24/7, including weekends
Offered under Ripple Prime’s Credit Intermediation Vehicle (CIV) license in the British Virgin Islands; other regions planned, no dates given
RLUSD collateral availability may vary by jurisdiction
Clients gain price exposure only, not ownership of the referenced assets

links.t: Unchained: swap structure, margin and licensing details

entries.head: EBA classifies USDC as the first significant e-money token under MiCA
entries.fact: On October 14 the European Banking Authority classified Circle’s USDC as a significant e-money token, the first of 45 notified in the EU. From November 12 the EBA takes over supervision of its reserves, own funds and liquidity from France’s ACPR.
entries.numLabel: EU e-money tokens notified under MiCA; USDC is first significant
entries.mechanism: Under the EU’s MiCA rules, a significant token falls under dual supervision: the EBA covers own funds, reserve assets, liquidity and recovery and redemption plans, while the national regulator keeps governance and related areas.
entries.implication: Stablecoins used as settlement cash for tokenized assets are gaining a single EU-level prudential supervisor, which sets a reference point for reserve and liquidity oversight.
evidence: EBA keeps reassessing significance each year
ACPR retains governance, qualifying holdings, fit-and-proper checks, outsourcing and conflicts of interest
EBA signed a memorandum of understanding with the New York State Department of Financial Services on cross-border stablecoin oversight

links.t: Ledger Insights: what the classification means for Circle’s reserves

entries.head: Perpetuals.com files notice for a tokenized-stock venue under the SEC innovation exemption
entries.fact: On October 14 Kephas Corporation, a Perpetuals.com subsidiary, published a notice for a Tokenized Securities Venue that relies on the SEC’s September 17 innovation exemption. The venue has not started trading and the notice gives no start date.
entries.numLabel: term of the SEC innovation exemption the venue relies on
entries.mechanism: Trading would run through permissioned automated market maker pools on Kronos X Public, an Ethereum-compatible layer-2 network, each pairing a tokenized stock with a form of USDC. Smart contracts set prices instead of an order book.
entries.implication: Alongside the OKXICE filing, the SEC’s exemption is moving from rule text to venue notices, with tokenized stocks trading on public blockchains the next test.
evidence: The notice cites SEC Release No. 34-106402 and says the venue is not registered with the SEC for activities under the exemption
The SEC order requires trading in a tokenized stock to halt when the underlying stock halts on its primary exchange
The SEC order requires smart contracts to be auditable, public and deployed on a public, permissionless blockchain
CoinDesk reports trading could begin in mid-November at the earliest

links.t: SEC: innovation exemption order for tokenized NMS stock
CoinDesk: venue plans, timing and company background

entries.head: BNY and Citadel Securities use a tokenized Treasury as collateral in a triparty repo
entries.fact: BNY said it completed a tokenized U.S. Treasury triparty repo with Citadel Securities, announced October 13. Citadel bought a 2-year Treasury note on Tradeweb, and BNY recorded a tokenized version that settled within minutes instead of the standard T+1.
entries.numLabel: standard settlement cycle; the tokenized note settled within minutes
entries.mechanism: BNY recorded a token of the Treasury note on its private digital ledger, then Citadel pledged it as collateral for an overnight loan of cash from BNY. The same asset moved from purchase to financing without waiting for the usual next-day settlement.
entries.implication: The test moves tokenization from issuance toward collateral use, where faster settlement frees cash. BNY says digital cash and tokenized deposits are next.
evidence: Citadel then used the token as overnight collateral and received cash from BNY
BNY calls it the first use of tokenized assets on a major triparty repo platform; the release does not name the platform
BNY did not disclose the trade size or repo rate
BNY plans digital cash and tokenized deposit tools, and longer settlement hours covering Europe and Asia next year

links.t: The Block: adds context on BNY's January tokenized deposit service

entries.head: Federated Hermes and Prometheum plan tokenized funds for brokerage accounts, first in Q1 2027
entries.fact: On October 13 Federated Hermes and Prometheum announced a partnership to issue and distribute tokenized securities funds through Prometheum’s SEC-registered, FINRA-member broker-dealer infrastructure. They expect the first tokenized fund in Q1 2027.
entries.numLabel: expected timing of the first tokenized fund
entries.mechanism: Prometheum’s broker-dealer arms would custody, clear and settle the tokenized fund shares and offer them to introducing broker-dealers through a correspondent clearing platform. The aim is to reach standard brokerage accounts rather than crypto-native platforms.
entries.implication: Distribution through ordinary brokerage channels is a different route from crypto-native platforms, but no fund, chain or eligibility terms are set yet.
evidence: Federated Hermes reported $911.6B in assets under management as of June 30, 2026
ProFinancial, a Prometheum unit, supports distribution
The release gives no fund name, blockchain, size or investor eligibility
Ledger Insights reports the first products are expected to be tokenized money market funds

source.n: Business Wire (Prometheum and Federated Hermes release)

links.t: Ledger Insights: adds context on Federated’s other tokenized fund access

entries.head: BNY Institute: Treasury settlement should run around the clock, with 24/7 clearing targeted for 2027
entries.fact: On October 13 BNY Institute published a paper arguing that Treasury settlement, funding and collateral must move toward always-on operation. BNY says it will extend settlement hours later in 2026 and target 24/7 clearing for traditional and tokenized Treasuries in 2027.
entries.numLabel: Treasury activity unsettled at the end of each day, per BNY
entries.mechanism: Tokenized securities, cash and collateral can carry rules inside settlement, so a collateral transfer can trigger automatically against a margin requirement or a financing leg. BNY adds that this still needs funding, collateral and balance sheet capacity.
entries.implication: A major custodian is placing tokenized Treasuries as a second rail inside Treasury settlement, alongside longer hours on existing systems.
evidence: Treasury venues can be open up to 22 hours a day, while about $239B of activity stays unsettled at each day's end
Roadmap: longer settlement hours for Fed-eligible assets later in 2026, then European and Asian hours in 2027
2027 targets include 24/7 bilateral and triparty financing across traditional and tokenized assets
Digital cash options named: tokenized money market funds, tokenized deposits and stablecoins

entries.head: Derivnex completes first OTC total return swap on Canton, between DRW and Marex
entries.fact: On October 13 Derivnex and Canton Network announced a total return swap between DRW and Marex Solutions referencing the iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade Index, tokenized by Kaiko. The release calls it the first OTC derivative on a fully tokenized index; that is the companies' own claim.
entries.mechanism: The trade's terms sit in a smart contract on Canton that both counterparties share, so valuations and other lifecycle events update one synchronized record instead of two reconciled ones. The reference index is itself a token, valued from official index data supplied by Kaiko.
entries.implication: Tokenization is extending from cash assets to derivative contracts and benchmark data, with collateral integration named as the next step.
evidence: Swap provider is Marex Solutions; counterparty is DRW
Kaiko distributed S&P Dow Jones Indices official index values used to value the position
Derivnex uses the Common Domain Model, a standard supported by ISDA
Next: equity and index derivatives, then digital cash and collateral on Canton

entries.head: TRON DAO reports $93.88B of USDT and USDD supply on TRON and $2.21T settled in Q3
entries.fact: TRON DAO's State of TRON Q3 2026 report, published 12 October, says stablecoin settlement on the network reached $2.21T in Q3, with USDT and USDD supply at $93.88B, up 5.5% from Q2.
entries.numLabel: USDT and USDD supply on TRON, Q3 2026 (TRON DAO)
entries.mechanism: Stablecoin supply and settlement volume show how much dollar-denominated value moves on a chain, which is the cash leg that tokenized assets settle against.
entries.implication: The figures are the issuer-network's own and unaudited here; read them as a signal of stablecoin activity, not an independent measure.
evidence: Average daily settlement volume rose 3.9% from Q2 to $24.05B, per the TRON DAO report as carried by NewsBTC.
TVL was $28.21B including staking and $13.05B excluding it (TRON DAO).
The piece is a TRON DAO press release distributed via BlockmanPR; the figures are not independently verified.

entries.head: Morgan Stanley now eyes Q1 2027 to support tokenized equities, after earlier H2 2026 target
entries.fact: Morgan Stanley's head of digital asset strategy, Amy Oldenburg, told The Block at Token2049 that support for tokenized equities on its trading system is now expected in Q1 2027; in March she pointed to the second half of 2026.
entries.numLabel: New target to support tokenized equities at Morgan Stanley
entries.mechanism: A bank can only support trading in tokenized shares once issuers have put suitable securities onchain. Oldenburg tied the delay to thin product supply and to open items such as DTCC's tokenization service, due at the end of October.
entries.implication: A large US bank is pushing back a timeline because tokenized product supply and market plumbing are not yet in place; adoption looks gated by infrastructure.
evidence: Oldenburg said client demand is limited because the product does not yet exist (The Block).
She cited DTCC's tokenization service launch at the end of October 2026 as a milestone the firm is watching (The Block).
She said the Clarity Act not passing is a factor, as is Federal Reserve permissibility (The Block).
crypto.news adds that she expects tokenized RWAs within a $3T-$10T range by 2030; this is her view, not a desk forecast.

links.t: crypto.news: Morgan Stanley sees tokenized assets at $3T-$10T by 2030

entries.head: Report: Stellar now hosts more tokenized assets than the XRP Ledger, at $3.5B vs $2.5B
entries.fact: 24/7 Wall St. reported on Oct 11 that Stellar holds about $3.5B in tokenized real-world assets versus $2.5B on the XRP Ledger, with Solana near $3B.
entries.numLabel: Tokenized assets on Stellar, per 24/7 Wall St.
entries.mechanism: Chain-level RWA totals depend on the aggregator and on what counts as a tokenized asset, so rankings can differ between data providers.
entries.implication: Single secondary source; the article names no data provider or as-of date, so the figures and their basis are unverified.
evidence: 24/7 Wall St. puts Stellar at $3.5B and the XRP Ledger at $2.5B in tokenized assets.
The article cites Solana at $3B and Avalanche at $1.7B.
It does not name its data source or give an as-of date for the totals.

entries.head: Nasdaq CEO: tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital
entries.fact: CNBC reports that Nasdaq’s CEO said tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital.
entries.mechanism: The claim concerns capital locked up by settlement delays and limited collateral mobility, the friction that on-ledger settlement is meant to reduce.
entries.implication: A second exchange operator in a week is framing tokenization as a capital-efficiency story. The desk could read only the headline at filing, so the figure and its basis are unverified; see the CNBC article.
evidence: The desk could read the headline only; the full article was not accessible at filing

entries.head: Securitize launches 1:1-backed tokenized stocks on Solana
entries.fact: On October 8 Securitize launched tokenized U.S. stocks backed 1:1 by shares held at Securitize Markets’ regulated brokerage, using a Convertible Entitlement Token structure. The tokens run on Solana, settle in USDC, and are open to eligible investors in the U.S., the EU and other jurisdictions.
entries.numLabel: backing by underlying shares held at a regulated brokerage
entries.mechanism: Holders receive shareholder rights, dividends and corporate-action entitlements through the token, and can move to an issuer-sponsored share structure if the issuer adopts one.
entries.implication: The entitlement lives in the token. Alongside the SEC’s September 17 exemption and the OKXICE filing, tokenized stocks are moving from announcement to product.
evidence: Initial names include Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Tesla, Meta and Amazon; SpaceX, Palantir, Circle and Strategy are expected
Extended U.S. market hours at first, with plans to expand toward 24/7 trading
CEO Carlos Domingo: “Tokenized stocks should give investors more than a price that happens to track a stock.”
Tokenized stocks had passed $3B of onchain value

entries.head: IMF: tokenized markets are about $65B against $300T of traditional assets
entries.fact: An analytical chapter of the IMF’s Global Financial Stability Report, as reported on October 8, puts tokenized real-world assets at about $65B against roughly $300T of traditional capital-market assets, and names four barriers: legal certainty, regulatory clarity, interoperability and settlement assets.
entries.numLabel: tokenized RWAs per the IMF, vs. about $300T in traditional capital markets
entries.mechanism: Two of the four barriers concern the rules around the token: whether holders can enforce the rights it represents, and how existing regulation applies to new ledgers.
entries.implication: The “settlement assets” barrier, a lack of safe and widely accepted money for settling trades, bears directly on native stablecoins such as TX’s announced USTX.
evidence: More than half of tokenized trading happened outside regular market hours
About 80% of the tokenized equity trades analyzed were for less than one share
Repo makes up most tokenized activity: roughly $300–350B of daily transactions, against about $13T of daily U.S. repo volume
The IMF says tokenized markets “remain inactive and more volatile than their traditional counterparts” and warns that scale could amplify fire sales and contagion

source.n: The Coin Republic, reporting the IMF Global Financial Stability Report

entries.head: Fidelity’s Horne: the line between TradFi and onchain may vanish into “just finance”
entries.fact: On a panel at Longitude Singapore on October 8, Matthew Horne, a Fidelity digital-asset strategy lead, said the gap between traditional and onchain finance might disappear, leaving what he called “just finance.”
entries.mechanism: The remark is about convergence: as assets and settlement move onto shared ledgers, “onchain” stops being a separate market.
entries.implication: Fidelity already offers onchain products, including tokenized exposure to money-market funds and U.S. Treasurys, so the comment comes from an operator, not an observer.
evidence: Reporter’s paraphrase: institutional assets are moving onchain quickly, and U.S. asset managers are motivated mainly by investor access and new markets

entries.head: OKXICE files to trade tokenized shares of 63 NYSE-listed companies
entries.fact: OKXICE LLC, a joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange, filed with the SEC on October 4 to offer tokenized shares of an initial 63 NYSE-listed companies, pending approval, under the SEC’s new innovation exemption.
entries.numLabel: NYSE-listed companies in the initial offering, pending approval
entries.mechanism: Issuers have 30 days to opt out before trading can begin, and tokenized securities must carry full shareholder rights such as dividends and voting.
entries.implication: The September 17 exemption now has its first filings: the venue, the opt-out window and the holder-rights conditions are written into the launch path.
evidence: ICE took a stake in OKX in March in a deal valuing the crypto firm at $25B
OKXICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo: “This is 24-hour, global stock market trading and has enormous advantages.”
Launch timing depends on the 30-day opt-out period and other requirements

entries.head: Two aggregators, two totals: $46.2B at Token Terminal, $38.61B at RWA.xyz
entries.fact: Token Terminal put tokenized real-world assets at about $46.2B across 35 to 36 networks in late September, excluding stablecoins. RWA.xyz showed $38.61B across 39 networks on October 1. The gap reflects methodology, including how distributed assets and cross-chain representations are counted.
entries.mechanism: Whether a token can move off the issuing platform decides which total it lands in.
entries.implication: Quote the aggregator and its definition together. The desk’s headline stays RWA.xyz distributed value.
evidence: Token Terminal: Ethereum about $22.2B (48%), BNB Chain $5.5B, Stellar and zkSync Era $3.3B each, Solana $3.0B
Categories: U.S. Treasury bills about $13.9B, active yield strategies $10.7B, credit funds $6.5B; tokenized stocks added about $592M in 30 days
Only about 7% to 12% of tokenized assets are used in DeFi
McKinsey projects about $2T by 2030, a forecast and not a guarantee
